# betterado_serviceendpoint_sonarcloud (Data Source)

Use this data source to access information about an existing SonarCloud Service Connection.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The project ID or project name.

### Optional

- `service_endpoint_id` (String) The service endpoint ID.
- `service_endpoint_name` (String) The service endpoint name.
